verdict.rationale: ClickUp's developer docs have a dedicated OpenAPI spec page stating that the raw OpenAPI specification is available for each version of the Public API, which directly meets the story. The probe's 404s only cover guessed generic paths, not the documented page, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: the actual download URL and format details (JSON/YAML), and hands-on confirmation that the spec file downloads successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The raw OpenAPI specification for the ClickUp API is available for each version of our Public API.
